mapper.select: select r.id, r.code, r.floor_id, f.name as floor_name, rt.price, b.id as bed_id, b.bed_number, b.bed_status, b.room_id, e.name as elder_name, e.id as elder_id from room r left join floor f on f.id = r.floor_id left join room_type rt on rt.id = r.room_type_id left join bed b on b.room_id = r.id left join elder e on e.bed_id = b.id where r.floor_id = #{floorId} order by r.sort, r.id, b.sort, b.id
select f.name as floorName, f.id as floorId, r.id as roomId, r.code, rt.price from floor f left join room r on f.id = r.floor_id left join room_type rt on r.room_type_id = rt.id where r.id = #{id}

select r.id, r.code, r.floor_id, f.name as floor_name, rt.price, b.id as bed_id, b.bed_number, b.bed_status, b.room_id, e.name as elder_name, e.id as elder_id from room r left join floor f on f.id = r.floor_id left join room_type rt on rt.id = r.room_type_id join bed b on b.room_id = r.id join elder e on e.bed_id = b.id where r.floor_id = #{floorId} order by r.sort, r.id, b.sort, b.id
